thread:
sarah_cs: Heads up — HelixCorp renewal popped. They want to move from 12mo to 9mo and are asking for a vendor code on the PO. Onboarding isn't finished (enablement kickoff next week). Procurement says no vendor code -> legal needs signoff. Risk: they said if we can't get vendor code + PO by Friday they might delay payment.

mike_sales: cc @sarah_cs — i asked their procurement for the vendor code yesterday, they said it's coming from their finance team but slow. Sales asked if we can do interim invoice to keep momentum?

claire_legal: We can approve a one-off signature path if finance is comfortable. Need the exact PO language. If the customer wants 9mo instead of 12, we need an amendment doc (simple SOW addendum) and to confirm proration calculation.

josef_finance: Interim invoice ok but prefer PO up front. If they sign 9mo, we'll prorate remaining months. Can accept wire or CC as fallback. If vendor code missing, we can accept an email approval + procurement-bot ticket from their side but it must come from an authorized approver.

nina_enablement: Onboarding status: training modules scheduled Wed next week, but they requested an extra enablement session for SSO and data access which we haven't scheduled. That was part of their condition for committing. Suggest we offer one extra 2hr session as part of renewal to keep them happy.

sarah_cs: Action list: 1) @mike_sales chase vendor code and authorized approver email. 2) @claire_legal draft 9mo amendment + fallback signature clause. 3) @josef_finance confirm interim invoice template and wire instructions. 4) @nina_enablement block 2hr session slot and offer short recording. I'll coordinate with the customer.

mike_sales: doing that now — pinging their procurement and cc'ing their FP&A lead. I'll ask if a vendor-code placeholder would work for now (we can update later).

procurement-bot: New ticket created: PR-98231 for HelixCorp vendor-code request. Assigned to helix-procurement. ETA 48h.

claire_legal: Drafted amendment and fallback clause, pushed to Google Drive: https://drive.redwood/helix/9mo-amendment (share restricted). If PO arrives, we switch to standard e-sign. If not, clause allows email approval from named approver + finance wire.

josef_finance: Interim invoice template attached (pdf). Wire details: Redwood Ltd. acct ****1234, swift REDWGB2L. We'll accept 50% upfront if that's what they need to expedite.

nina_enablement: Blocked Tuesday 10–12 for the extra session. I'll prepare a 30-min checklist for them to fill before the kickoff so we don't waste time. Also will prep a short recorded walkthrough for SSO steps.

sarah_cs: Thanks team. Risk level: moderate-high until PO or authorization email is in. If nothing by Friday EOD, escalate to AM and propose 50% wire and onboarding hold lifted once payment confirmed. I'll update thread when I hear from procurement. :thumbsup:

mike_sales: update — procurement replied, vendor code "VC-9876" but they need it on the PO number field, not vendor code field. I told them finance can accept placeholder PO and amend later. I pasted their approver email in DM to @josef_finance.

josef_finance: Received approver email and vendor code. Creating draft interim invoice now. Will send with wire + CC options and note 50% upfront possibility.

sarah_cs: Perfect. Closing loop: once invoice is out, @nina_enablement run the kickoff regardless of signed amendment to keep onboarding momentum (we'll mark as contingent). That should reduce churn risk.

claire_legal: Noted — we'll keep amendment ready and convert to e-sign as soon as PO/approval comes through.

sarah_cs: Thanks all. Marking this thread: follow-ups — invoice sent, enablement session held, amendment signed. I'll update statuses here.
